correctness.rationale: An idempotent strict path endomorphism fixes precisely its image interval. Independent endpoint-starting walks on the two complementary tails yield the exact finite convolution. The sine eigenbasis of the path adjacency matrix gives coefficients 2(1+cos(j*pi/(r+1)))/(r+1) for odd j. The negative top-modulus eigenvalue, when present, has coefficient O(r^-3) versus the positive principal O(r^-1). Uniform summable subprincipal-mode bounds justify the rank-window asymptotic. The saddle has unique minimizer c=(pi^2/log 2)^(1/3) and second derivative 3 log 2/c, proving the Gaussian sixth-root fluctuations. Exact independent brute-force enumeration matched the transfer recurrence for n=2..11. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Retract-image rank is a fundamental semigroup invariant, and its exact spectrum is naturally motivated by endomorphism/idempotent structure. The full convolution, stretched-exponential total, and nondegenerate sixth-root Gaussian fluctuations quantify the rank of a typical retract and give sharp variance beyond merely locating the dominant cubic-root scale. The result is an infinite-family probabilistic theorem, not a short finite-table recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
